steps.action: Ask for approval, steps 1-3: open the Contract's Approvals tab, Add approver, choose Priya Raman and Business User Lena Vogel under Approvers, Request approvals
steps.expected: The picker offers all active users including Business Users and not archived people; both new rows are Pending at once; a person with a pending request is not offered again.
steps.actual: The Approvals tab ("Approvals", landing on /contracts/136/approvals) > Add approver listed 38 people under Approvers, including Business Users Lena Vogel and Jonas Weber and not archived Gabriel Santos. After Request approvals: ["Priya Raman:pending","Lena Vogel:pending"]. The reopened picker offered 36 people and not Priya Raman or Lena Vogel.

steps.action: Give a decision: with in-app notifications on, a request made by someone else is pinned under Your approvals with Review; the requester's own request is not pinned for them
steps.expected: Priya's bell pins the request with Review, which opens the Contract's approvals; A's bell has no pinned item for a request A made to themselves.
steps.actual: Priya Raman's "Assigned to you" in-app preference is true. Her bell showed Your approvals with 1 item(s); the one for this Contract read "Unread Nadia Haddad asked you to approve DOC-032 contracts V-C16 legal_team_member approvals 1790580495073 this minute Review" with Review (/contracts/136/approvals), which opened /contracts/136/approvals. Nadia Haddad (in-app true) then asked themselves; their bell's Your approvals held 1 item(s) and none for this Contract. That self request was cancelled.

steps.action: Give a decision: only the named person can answer; other people see no Approve or Reject; the dialog says a decision is final; Note; Reject in the dialog; the row shows Rejected with the note; the pinned item goes
steps.expected: A sees only Cancel request on Priya's row and a direct decision is refused; Priya rejects with a Note; Rejected row and note; a second decision is refused; Priya's pinned item is gone.
steps.actual: Nadia Haddad's actions on Priya's row: ["Cancel request"]; a direct decision answered 403 ("Only the approver named on this request can decide it."). Priya's own actions: ["Approve","Reject"]. Reject opened "Reject this contract A decision is final. To change it, ask for a new approval. Note Cancel Reject". With a Note she selected Reject in the dialog. Nadia Haddad's row: "PR Priya Raman Requested by Nadia Haddad Added manually Rejected DOC-032 contracts V-C16 needs a lower liability cap. Sep 28". A second decision answered 409; Priya's decided-row actions: no Actions button. Her bell no longer pins this request (0 other pinned item(s)).

steps.action: Approve from the business portal: Approvals in the Portal navigation bar, Your approvals, Pending and Completed, search by Contract title, open the request, primary Document with Download, Note (optional), Approve saves at once; the decision shows on the Contract; the Portal bell links to the review page
steps.expected: Lena finds the request under Pending, reviews the primary Document, approves with a note without a confirmation; Completed lists it; the Contract row shows Approved with her note.
steps.actual: Lena Vogel's Portal bell item for this Contract linked to "/portal/approvals/01a0e6ea-234e-725b-93f3-e95f4727ce09". Approvals in the Portal navigation opened "Your approvals" with ["Pending","Completed"] (Pending current: true). Searching the Contract title listed ["C-136DOC-032 contracts V-C16 legal_team_member approvals 1790580495073 NH Nadia Haddad Sep 28, 2026, 11:28 AM GMT+4 Pending"]. The request opened /portal/approvals/01a0e6ea-234e-725b-93f3-e95f4727ce09; the page showed "All approvals C-136 DOC-032 contracts V-C16 legal_team_member approvals 1790580495073 Pending doc032-contracts-legal_team_member-approval.pdf Download Opening… Approval request NH Requested by Nadia Haddad Requested Sep 28, 2026, 11:28 AM GMT+4 Your decision N" with 1 Download control(s). Approve with a Note saved at once (approved); no confirmation appeared. Completed lists the request. On the Contract: "LV Lena Vogel Requested by Nadia Haddad Added manually Approved DOC-032 contracts V-C16 business sign-off given. Sep 28". Lena is not on the Contract team (["Nadia Haddad"]).

steps.action: To ask again after a decision, add a new approval request; the earlier decision stays in history
steps.expected: A new Pending row for Priya Raman; the Rejected row stays.
steps.actual: Priya Raman now has ["rejected","pending"] requests on C-136.

steps.action: Apply group: choose the Approver group, inspect the named people and the skipped pending requests, select Apply group in the dialog; later group edits do not rewrite existing requests
steps.expected: The dialog asks Marcus and skips Priya; Apply group creates Marcus's Pending row; an Administrator's later group edit leaves the requests as they are.
steps.actual: The dialog started on "Pick a group" (this MSA Contract has no default group). With "DOC-032 contracts V-C16 sign-off 1790580495073" chosen it read "Asks Marcus Oyelaran. Skips 1 person who already has a request open. Applying a group asks the people it names now. A later edit to the group leaves these requests as they are. Cancel Apply group". Apply group added Marcus's row "MO Marcus Oyelaran Requested by Nadia Haddad DOC-032 contracts V-C16 sign-off 1790580495073 Pending — —". Requests: ["Priya Raman:rejected:manual","Lena Vogel:approved:manual","Priya Raman:pending:manual","Marcus Oyelaran:pending:group"]. Daniel Okafor added Tom Iwu to the group (200); requests stayed ["Priya Raman:rejected:manual","Lena Vogel:approved:manual","Priya Raman:pending:manual","Marcus Oyelaran:pending:group"]; the group was then put back.

steps.action: Cancel request: the requester, the Legal Owner or an Administrator can cancel a pending request at once without a confirmation; others cannot; a decided approval is not erased
steps.expected: Marcus (not requester, Legal Owner or Administrator) has no Cancel request on Priya's pending row and is refused; A cancels Marcus's pending row with no confirmation and History records it; the other permitted person cancels Priya's pending row; decided rows stay and cannot be cancelled.
steps.actual: Marcus Oyelaran's actions on Priya's pending row: no Actions button; a direct cancel answered 403. Nadia Haddad's Cancel request removed Marcus's pending row at once; 0 confirmation dialogs appeared. Daniel Okafor as Administrator (not the requester or Legal Owner) cancelled Priya's second pending request. Decided rows stayed: ["Priya Raman:rejected","Lena Vogel:approved"]; actions on Priya's decided row: none; cancelling a decided one answered 409. History: ["Daniel Okafor cancelled the approval request to Priya Raman this minute Nadia Haddad cancelled the appr","Priya Raman rejected this contract this minute Nadia Haddad cancelled the approval request to Nadia Haddad this minute Nadia Haddad asked Nadia Hadda"].

steps.action: Move beyond Approval: Move past approval lists Pending and Rejected rows; Cancel keeps the current Status; Move anyway saves it and records an override; the approvals keep their decisions
steps.expected: The dialog lists the unresolved rows; Cancel keeps Awaiting approval; Move anyway saves Active; History records the override; decisions unchanged.
steps.actual: Dialog: "Move past approval 2 approvals on this contract are unresolved. Moving to Active goes past sign-off. PR Priya Raman Rejected TI Tom Iwu Pending This is allowed. It is recorded on the record's activity as an override. Cancel Move anyway". Cancel kept "Awaiting approval"; Move anyway saved Active. History: "Nadia Haddad moved this contract past approval, overriding Priya Raman and Tom Iwu this minute Nadia Haddad changed the status". Approvals afterwards: ["Priya Raman:rejected","Lena Vogel:approved","Tom Iwu:pending"].

steps.action: On a Confidential Contract the picker offers only staff who can already open it plus Business Users; if the primary Document is Confidential a staff approver outside its audience is refused by name and a Business approver is not refused but sees no Document
steps.expected: Confidential Contract: Priya and Marcus not offered, Lena offered. Open Contract with a Confidential primary Document: Marcus refused by name and no request made; Lena asked; her review page shows No document attached.
steps.actual: Confidential C-147: the picker offered 27 people; the seeded ones were ["Ade Balogun","Amara Nwosu","Clara Fontaine","Daniel Okafor","Devon Calloway","Diego Salas","Felix Brandt","Jonas Weber","Karim Aziz","Lena Vogel","Mei Tanaka","Nadia Haddad","Oliver Grant","Ravi Menon","Rosa Iglesias","Sara Haddadi"] (no Priya Raman or Marcus Oyelaran; Business Users present). Open C-148 with its primary Document marked Confidential (200): asking Marcus Oyelaran showed "Marcus Oyelaran can't see this contract, so they can't be asked to approve it." and 0 requests exist. Asking Lena Vogel succeeded; her review page read "All approvals C-148 DOC-032 contracts V-C16 legal_team_member confidential document 1790580495073 Pending Primary document No document attached No primary document is available. Contact the requester if you need a docume".

steps.action: A Contract inherits its type's default group; the dialog starts on it; under Administrators only a Legal Team Member cannot change the choice and sees Only an administrator can choose a different group.; an archived default shows Default group unavailable — contact an administrator
steps.expected: Dialog starts on the default; the lock follows the role and the setting; the archived default reads as unavailable and another group can be chosen by someone allowed to override.
steps.actual: C-150 of type "DOC-032 contracts V-C16 Default group type 1790580495073" opened Apply approver group on "DOC-032 contracts V-C16 default group 1790580495073" (select enabled: true). With the organization setting at Administrators only (set 200, restored right after), the select was disabled and the dialog said "Only an administrator can choose a different group."; applying a different group through the API answered 403. With the default group archived (200) the dialog started on "Default group unavailable — contact an administrator" and the select was enabled for this person; the group was restored.
